overall: At 4:50 AM ET, NYC is in the typical overnight cool-down phase with temps sitting at 72°F after a running max of 73.9°F hit just after midnight — entirely expected nocturnal behavior. A Heat Advisory is in effect through Tuesday 9 PM EDT, with heat index values up to 104°F forecast for Manhattan, Brooklyn, Bronx, and Staten Island, signaling a seriously hot afternoon ahead.
forecast_obs_notes: NWP models are in broad agreement on a very hot day but show meaningful spread: GFS (98.8°F) and HRRR (98.1°F) are bullish and clustered near 99°F, while ECMWF (94.4°F), NBM (95.9°F), and the NWS official forecast (95°F) form a cooler cluster. The INTRADAY model is essentially uninformative this early in the day — it is anchored to the 73.9°F overnight low and cannot yet capture the full diurnal signal, so NWP guidance is the primary signal for today's high.
max_temp_prediction: With peak heating expected around 16–17h ET (4–5 PM local) and strong SW flow supporting heat advection, the daily high will almost certainly land in the 94–99°F range. The GFS/HRRR cluster near 98–99°F may be slightly aggressive given ECMWF's more conservative 94.4°F read; blending toward the NWS official of 95°F and NBM's 95.9°F, a best estimate of ~96–97°F seems reasonable. Confidence is moderate — model spread of ~4°F is notable.
